claims_review.bounds: K bounds admitted work/result credits and the demonstrated one-primary-reader composition. Provider arrays/archive state, arbitrary callback opens/allocations and parser/index payloads remain additional costs.
claims_review.generic_callback_content_ownership: Only the callback can establish EOF and close its outer monitored/shadow/capture layer; a generic FileTask result alone is not complete content evidence.
claims_review.identities: Raw bytes, decoded UTF-16, exact spans and structural hashes are separately framed syntax evidence; no atomic filesystem snapshot or semantic equivalence is claimed.
claims_review.publication_boundary: Individual completed callback results can precede region manager close; successful terminal exhaustion/close waits workers and cleanup. Owning facts Stream is closed before commit.

resolved_findings.control_flow: transaction() commits before finally restoring autocommit; Path overload closes its owned connection after transaction() returns. Either cleanup can throw after commit.
resolved_findings.original_claim: A failure rolls back this generation, preserving earlier generations and unrelated caller work.
resolved_findings.resolution: Documentation now says pre-publication failure attempts rollback and explicitly states post-commit restore/close failure cannot retract the committed generation; callers must distinguish failure from non-publication.
